```{r}
run_trait_signal <- TRUE

# Set the reference level you want for climate_group coefficients.
```

```{r}

# -------------------------
# 2. Helper functions
# -------------------------
clean_species_names <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    stringr::str_trim() %>%
    gsub('"', '', .) %>%
    gsub("'", "", .) %>%
    gsub(" ", "_", .) %>%
    stringr::str_to_lower()
}

read_clean_tree <- function(file_path, outgroup = NULL) {
  # Try nexus first, then plain Newick
  tr <- tryCatch(
    read.nexus(file_path),
    error = function(e) read.tree(file_path)
  )

  if (inherits(tr, "multiPhylo")) {
    tr <- tr[[1]]
  }

  if (!inherits(tr, "phylo")) {
    stop("Tree could not be read as a phylo object.")
  }

  tr$tip.label <- clean_species_names(tr$tip.label)

  if (!is.null(outgroup) && outgroup %in% tr$tip.label) {
    tr <- root(tr, outgroup = outgroup, resolve.root = TRUE)
  }

  if (!is.null(tr$edge.length)) {
    tr$edge.length[tr$edge.length <= 0] <- 1e-8
  }

  # Clear node labels because they are not needed for comparative analyses
  tr$node.label <- NULL
  tr
}

prepare_shared_dataset <- function(df, tree, response, predictors) {
  vars_needed <- c(response, predictors)

  df_model <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(species, dplyr::all_of(vars_needed)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na() %>%
    dplyr::filter(species %in% tree$tip.label)

  if (nrow(df_model) < 3) {
    stop(paste("Too few species remain after filtering for", response))
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(df_model$species)) {
    dupes <- unique(df_model$species[duplicated(df_model$species)])
    stop(
      paste(
        "Duplicate species names found after filtering:",
        paste(dupes, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }

  spp <- df_model$species
  tree_model <- ape::drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, spp))
  tree_model$edge.length[tree_model$edge.length <= 0] <- 1e-8
  tree_model$node.label <- NULL

  idx <- match(tree_model$tip.label, df_model$species)

  if (any(is.na(idx))) {
    stop("Some tree tips could not be matched back to df_model after pruning.")
  }

  df_model <- df_model[idx, , drop = FALSE]

  if (!all(df_model$species == tree_model$tip.label)) {
    stop("Data species do not match tree tip labels after pruning/reordering.")
  }

  df_model <- as.data.frame(df_model)
  rownames(df_model) <- NULL

  list(
    data = df_model,
    tree = tree_model
  )
}

```

```{r}
make_comparative_data <- function(df_model, tree_model) {
  df_model <- as.data.frame(df_model)
  rownames(df_model) <- df_model$species

  if (anyDuplicated(rownames(df_model))) {
    stop("Duplicate row names remain in df_model.")
  }

  if (nrow(df_model) != length(tree_model$tip.label)) {
    stop("Row count of df_model does not equal number of tree tips.")
  }

  if (!all(rownames(df_model) == tree_model$tip.label)) {
    stop("Row names of df_model do not exactly match tree tip labels.")
  }

  caper::comparative.data(
    phy = tree_model,
    data = df_model,
    names.col = "species",
    vcv = TRUE,
    warn.dropped = TRUE
  )
}

fit_pgls_model <- function(formula, comp_data) {
  caper::pgls(
    formula = formula,
    data = comp_data,
    lambda = "ML"
  )
}

extract_pgls_coefficients <- function(model, response_name, model_name) {
  coef_tab <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients)
  coef_tab$term <- rownames(coef_tab)
  rownames(coef_tab) <- NULL

  data.frame(
    response = response_name,
    model_name = model_name,
    term = coef_tab$term,
    estimate = coef_tab[["Estimate"]],
    std_error = coef_tab[["Std. Error"]],
    t_value = coef_tab[["t value"]],
    p_value = coef_tab[["Pr(>|t|)"]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

extract_pgls_model_summary <- function(model, response_name, model_name, predictors_string) {
  s <- summary(model)

  data.frame(
    response = response_name,
    model_name = model_name,
    predictors = predictors_string,
    N = nobs(model),
    k = attr(logLik(model), "df"),
    logLik = as.numeric(logLik(model)),
    AIC = AIC(model),
    AICc = MuMIn::AICc(model),
    intercept = unname(coef(model)[1]),
    pagel_lambda = unname(model$param["lambda"]),
    residual_se = s$sigma,
    R2 = s$r.squared,
    adj_R2 = as.numeric(s$adj.r.squared),
    F = unname(s$fstatistic[1]),
    F_df1 = unname(s$fstatistic[2]),
    F_df2 = unname(s$fstatistic[3]),
    model_p = stats::pf(
      q = unname(s$fstatistic[1]),
      df1 = unname(s$fstatistic[2]),
      df2 = unname(s$fstatistic[3]),
      lower.tail = FALSE
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

run_pgls_model_set <- function(df, tree, response, predictors, formulas_named, predictor_labels = NULL) {
  prep <- prepare_shared_dataset(
    df = df,
    tree = tree,
    response = response,
    predictors = predictors
  )

  comp_data <- make_comparative_data(prep$data, prep$tree)

  fitted_models <- purrr::map(formulas_named, fit_pgls_model, comp_data = comp_data)

  coefficient_table <- purrr::imap_dfr(
    fitted_models,
    ~extract_pgls_coefficients(.x, response_name = response, model_name = .y)
  )

  if (is.null(predictor_labels)) {
    predictor_labels <- stats::setNames(names(formulas_named), names(formulas_named))
  }

  model_summary_table <- purrr::imap_dfr(
    fitted_models,
    ~extract_pgls_model_summary(
      .x,
      response_name = response,
      model_name = .y,
      predictors_string = predictor_labels[[.y]]
    )
  )

  model_summary_table <- model_summary_table %>%
    dplyr::arrange(AICc) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      deltaAICc = AICc - min(AICc, na.rm = TRUE),
      akaike_weight = exp(-0.5 * deltaAICc) / sum(exp(-0.5 * deltaAICc), na.rm = TRUE),
      is_best_model = deltaAICc == min(deltaAICc, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  list(
    comparative_data = comp_data,
    tree = prep$tree,
    data = prep$data,
    fitted_models = fitted_models,
    coefficients = coefficient_table,
    model_summary = model_summary_table
  )
}

estimate_trait_signal <- function(tree, df, trait_col) {
  d <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(species, all_of(trait_col)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na() %>%
    dplyr::filter(species %in% tree$tip.label)

  tree_trait <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, d$species))
  if (!is.null(tree_trait$edge.length)) {
    tree_trait$edge.length[tree_trait$edge.length <= 0] <- 1e-8
  }

  d <- d %>%
    dplyr::slice(match(tree_trait$tip.label, species))

  x <- d[[trait_col]]
  names(x) <- d$species

  lambda_fit <- phytools::phylosig(tree_trait, x, method = "lambda", test = TRUE)
  k_fit <- phytools::phylosig(tree_trait, x, method = "K", test = TRUE)

  tibble::tibble(
    trait = trait_col,
    N = length(x),
    pagel_lambda_trait = lambda_fit$lambda,
    pagel_lambda_logL = lambda_fit$logL,
    pagel_lambda_P = lambda_fit$P,
    blomberg_K = k_fit$K,
    blomberg_K_P = k_fit$P
  )
}

reconcile_species_names <- function(x) {
  x <- clean_species_names(x)

  recode_map <- c(
    "amanita_muscariaflavivolvata" = "amanita_muscaria_flavivolvata",
    "limacella_illinita" = "zhuliangomyces_illinitus",
    "amanita_phalloides" = "amanita_phalloides_sensu_auct._amer."
  )

  dplyr::recode(x, !!!recode_map, .default = x)
}
```

```{r}

# -------------------------
# 3. Input files
# -------------------------
pca_file  <- "Results/PCA/PCA_Spore_Scores_Aggregated_with_Count.csv"
vol_file  <- "Results/Volume/Volume.csv"
loc_file  <- "Results/Weather/Location_Date_Outliers_Removed.csv"
clim_file <- "Results/Climate/Amanita_Climate_Summary.csv"
tree_file <- "Results/Phylogeny/species_tree_output.tree"

input_files <- c(pca_file, vol_file, loc_file, clim_file, tree_file)
missing_files <- input_files[!file.exists(input_files)]
if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop("These required input files were not found:\n", paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n"))
}

# -------------------------
# 4. Load and merge data
# -------------------------
pca <- readr::read_csv(pca_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(species = clean_species_names(species))

vol <- readr::read_csv(vol_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(species = clean_species_names(species))

loc <- readr::read_csv(loc_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(species = clean_species_names(species))

clim <- readr::read_csv(clim_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(species = clean_species_names(species))

df_full <- pca %>%
  dplyr::left_join(vol,  by = "species") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(loc,  by = "species") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(clim, by = "species")

df_full <- df_full %>%
  dplyr::mutate(species = reconcile_species_names(species))

required_columns <- c(
  "species", "PC1_mean", "avg_volume_estimated",
  "Precipitation_monthly", "climate_group"
)
missing_columns <- required_columns[!required_columns %in% colnames(df_full)]
if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "These required columns are missing after merging: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

df_full <- df_full %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    climate_group = as.factor(climate_group)
  )

if (!is.null(climate_reference_level) && climate_reference_level %in% levels(df_full$climate_group)) {
  df_full$climate_group <- stats::relevel(df_full$climate_group, ref = climate_reference_level)
}


```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# 5. Read and clean tree
# -------------------------
tree <- read_clean_tree(tree_file, outgroup = outgroup_name)
tree$tip.label <- clean_species_names(tree$tip.label)
tree$tip.label <- reconcile_species_names(tree$tip.label)
# -------------------------
# 6. Optional: phylogenetic signal of raw traits
# -------------------------
trait_signal_results <- TRUE
if (isTRUE(run_trait_signal)) {
  trait_signal_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    estimate_trait_signal(tree, df_full, "PC1_mean"),
    estimate_trait_signal(tree, df_full, "avg_volume_estimated")
  )
}
```

```{r}
pc1_formulas <- list(
  mod_shape1_PC1_Precipitation = PC1_mean ~ Precipitation_monthly,
  mod_shape2_PC1_Climate = PC1_mean ~ climate_group,
  mod_shape3_PC1_Precip_Climate = PC1_mean ~ Precipitation_monthly + climate_group
)

pc1_labels <- c(
  mod_shape1_PC1_Precipitation = "Precipitation_monthly",
  mod_shape2_PC1_Climate = "climate_group",
  mod_shape3_PC1_Precip_Climate = "Precipitation_monthly + climate_group"
)

pc1_results <- run_pgls_model_set(
  df = df_full,
  tree = tree,
  response = "PC1_mean",
  predictors = c("Precipitation_monthly", "climate_group"),
  formulas_named = pc1_formulas,
  predictor_labels = pc1_labels
)
```

```{r}

all_coefficients <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  pc1_results$coefficients,
  volume_results$coefficients
)

all_model_summaries <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  pc1_results$model_summary,
  volume_results$model_summary
)

best_models <- all_model_summaries %>%
  dplyr::group_by(response) %>%
  dplyr::filter(deltaAICc == min(deltaAICc, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

best_model_coefs <- all_coefficients %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    best_models %>% dplyr::select(response, model_name),
    by = c("response", "model_name")
  )

dir.create("Results/stats/PGLS", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

readr::write_csv(all_coefficients, "Results/stats/PGLS/pgls_coefficients_all.csv")
readr::write_csv(all_model_summaries, "Results/stats/PGLS/pgls_model_summaries_all.csv")
readr::write_csv(best_models, "Results/stats/PGLS/pgls_best_models.csv")
readr::write_csv(best_model_coefs, "Results/stats/PGLS/pgls_best_model_coefficients.csv")
```
